spans.s:
सधर्मन् a.
1 Having similar
properties.
--2 Having similar duties.
--3 Of the same sect or caste.
--4
Like, resembling.
--Comp.
--चारिणी a legal wife, a legally
married wife.
सधिस् m. An ox, a bull.

साध् {vI.v} {c5c} P. (साध्नोति)
1 To
complete, finish, accomplish.
--2 To
conquer. {vII.v} {c4c} P. (साध्यति) To
be completed or accomplished.
--

To accomplish, effect,
bring about, perform; अपि साधय
साधयेप्सितं

.
--2
To complete, finish, conclude.
--3
To gain, secure, obtain;

.
--4 To prove,
substantiate.
--5 To subdue, overpower,
conquer (as a foe &c.), win
over; न हि साम्ना न दानेन न भेदेन च
पांडवाः । शक्याः साधयितुं Mb.
--6 To kill,
destroy; सुग्रीवांतकमासेदुः साधयिष्याम
इत्यरिं

.
--7 To learn,
understand.
--8 To cure, heal.
--9
To go, depart, go one's way;
साधयाम्यहमविघ्नमस्तु ते

;
Ś. 1. 7; प्रायेण ण्यंतकः साधिर्गमेरर्थे प्रयुज्यते
S. D.
--10 To recover (as a debt).
--11 To make perfect.

साधक a. [साध्-ण्वुल्, सिध्-णिच् ण्वुल्
साधादेशः वा Tv.] (धका or धिका f.)
1 Accomplishing, fulfilling,
effecting, completing.
--2 Efficient,
effective;

.
--3
Skilful, adept.
--4 Effecting by
[]
magic, magical.
--5 Assisting, helping.
--कः A magician, one possessed of
supernatural powers, a yogin;

साधन a. (नी f.) [साध् णिच् ल्यु
ल्युद् वा] Accomplishing, effecting
&c.
--नं
1 Accomplishing, effecting,
performing; as in स्वार्थसाधनं.
--2
Fulfilment, accomplishment,
complete attainment of an object;
प्रजार्थसाधने तौ हि पर्यायोद्यतकार्मुकौ

.
--3 A means, an expedient, a
means of accomplishing anything;
शरीरमाद्यं खलु धर्मसाधनं

.
--4 An
instrument, agent; कुठारः
छिदिक्रियासाधनम्.
--5 The efficient cause, source,
cause in general.
--6 The instrumental
case.
--7 Implement, apparatus.
--8
Appliance, materials.
--9 Matter,
ingredients, substance.
--10 An
army or a part thereof;

.
--11 Aid, help, assistance (in
general).
--12 Proof, substantiation,
demonstration.
--13 The hetu or
middle term in a syllogism, reason,
that which leads to a conclusion;
साध्ये निश्चितमन्वयेन घटितं बिभ्रत्सपक्षे
स्थितिं व्यावृत्तं च विपक्षतो भवति
यत्तत्साधनं सिद्धये

.
--14
Subduing, overcoming.
--15 Subduing
by charms.
--16 Accomplishing
anything by charms or magic.
--17
Healing, curing.
--18 Killing,
destroying; फलं च तस्य प्रतिसाधनं

.
--19 Conciliating,
propitiating, winning over.
--20 Going
out, setting forward, departure.
--21
Going after, following.
--22
Penance, self-mortification.
--23
Attainment of final beatitude.
--24 A
medicinal preparation, drug,
medicine.
--25 (In law) Enforcement
of the delivery of anything, or of
the payment of debt,
infliction of fine.
--26 A bodily organ.
--27 The penis.
--28 An udder.
--29
Wealth.
--30 Friendship.
--31 Profit,
advantage.
--32 Burning a dead
body.
--33 Obsequies.
--34 Killing
or oxydation of metals.
--Comp.
अर्ह a. worthy of being proved or
accomplished.
--क्रिया {1} a finite
verb. {2} an action connected with
a Kāraka.
--पत्रं a document used
as evidence.

1 Accomplishment,
fulfilment, completion.
--2 Worship,
adoration.
--3 Conciliation,
propitiation.

साधनता, --त्वं
1 The state of
[]
having means, possession of means to
accomplish a desired object;
प्रतिकूलतामुपगते हि विधौ विफलत्वमेति
बहुसाधनता Śi. 9. 6.
--2 The state of
perfection.

साधनता, --त्वं
1 The state of
[]
having means, possession of means to
accomplish a desired object;
प्रतिकूलतामुपगते हि विधौ विफलत्वमेति
बहुसाधनता Śi. 9. 6.
--2 The state of
perfection.

1 A skilful or
accomplished woman.
--2 Deep sleep.

साधित p. p.
1 Accomplished
effected, achieved.
--2 Completed,
finished.
--3 Proved, demonstrated.
--4
Obtained, secured.
--5 Discharged.
--6 Overcome, subdued.
--7 Made
good, recovered.
--8 Fined.
--9 Made
to pay.
--10 Awarded (as fine or
punishment).

साध्य a. [साध्-णिच् यत्]
1 To be
effected or accomplished, to be
brought about; साध्ये सिद्धिर्विधीयतां

.
--2 Feasible, practicable,
attainable.
--3 To be proved or
demonstrated; आप्तवागनुमानाभ्यां साध्यं
त्वां प्रति का कथा

.
--4 To
be established or made good.
--5
To be inferred or concluded;
अनुमानं तदुक्तं यत्साध्यसाधनयोर्वचः
K.

.
--7 Curable.
--8 To be killed or
destroyed.
--ध्यः
1 A particular class
of celestial beings; cf.

.
--2 A deity in general.
--3 N.
of a Mantra.
--ध्यं
1
Accomplishment, perfection.
--2 The thing to
be proved or established, the
matter at issue.
--3 (In logic) The
predicate of a proposition, the
major term in a syllogism; साध्ये
निश्चितमन्वयेन घटितं…… &c. ; यत्साध्यं
स्वयमेव तुल्यमुभयोः पक्षे विरुद्धं च यत्

.
--Comp.
--अभावः the
absence of the major term.
--ऋषिः
an epithet of Śiva.
--पक्षः the plaint
in a law-suit.
--सिद्धिः f. {1}
accomplishment. {2} conclusion. ˚पादः
judgment, decision.

1 Feasibility,
practicability.
--2 Curableness.
--Comp.
--अवच्छेदकं that which marks out
or measures the साध्य or major term,
its characteristic property.

साध्यवत् m. The party on whom
rests the onus probandi or burden
of proof in a law-suit. --n. That
[]
which contains the साध्य or major
term.

1 Sameness or
community of duty, office &c.; पंचमं
लोकपालानामूचुः साधर्म्ययोगतः

.
--2 Sameness of nature, common
character, likeness, community of
properties; साधर्म्यमुपमा भेदे
K.

साधारण a. (णा or णी f.)
1
Common (to two or more), joint;
साधारणोऽयं प्रणयः Ś. 3; साधारणो
भूषणभूष्यभावः

.
--2
Ordinary, common; साधारणी न खलु
बाधा भवस्य

.
--3 General,
universal.
--4 Mingled, mixed with,
in common with; उत्कंठासाधारणं
परितोषमनुभवामि Ś. 4; वीज्यते स हि संसुप्तः
श्वाससाधारणानिलैः

.
--5
Equal, similar, like.
--6 (In logic)
Belonging to more than one
instance alleged, one of the three
divisions of the fallacy called अनैकांतिक
q.v.
--णं
1 A common or general rule,
a rule or precept generally
applicable.
--2 A generic property.
--Comp.
--देशः a wild marshy country.
--धनं joint property.
--धर्मः {1} a
common or universal duty; (अहिंसा
सत्यमस्तेयं शौचमिंद्रियनिग्रहः । दंभः
क्षमार्जवं दानं धर्मं साधारणं विदुः ॥) {2} the
common duty of procreation; (
प्रजनार्थं स्त्रियः सृष्ठाः संतानार्थं च मानवाः ।
तस्मात्साधारणो धर्मः श्रुतौ पत्न्या सहोदितः ॥).
--स्त्री a common woman, harlot,
prostitute.

साधारणता त्वं
1 Community,
universality.
--2 Joint interest.

साधारणता त्वं
1 Community,
universality.
--2 Joint interest.

1 A twig of bamboo.
--2
A key.

साधारणीकृ {c8c} U. To share with,
divide; केन वान्येन साधारणीकरोमि दुःखं
K.

साधु a. (धु or ध्वी f.; compar.
साधीयस्; superl. साधिष्ठ) [साध्-उन्]
1 Good,
excellent, perfect; यद्यत्साधु न
चित्रे स्याक्त्रियते तत्तदन्यथा Ś. 6. 13;
आपरितोषाद्विदुषां न साधु मन्ये
प्रयोगविज्ञानं 1. 2.
--2 Fit, proper, right;
as in साधुवृत्त, साधुसमाचार.
--3
Virtuous, righteous, honourable, pious.
--4 (a) Kind, well-disposed;
[]

. (b)
Well-behaved (with loc.); मातरि साधुः Sk.
--5 Correct, pure, classical (as
language).
--6 Pleasing, agreeable,
pleasant; अतोऽर्हसि क्षंतुमसाधु साधु
वा

.
--7 Noble, well-born,
of noble descent.
--धुः
1 A good or
virtuous man;

.
--2 A sage, saint; साधोः
प्रकोपितस्यापि मनो नायाति विक्रियां
Subhāṣ.
--3 A merchant;

.
--4 A Jaina saint.
--5 A usurer,
money-lender. --ind.
1 Well,
welldone, very nice, bravo; साधु गीतं
Ś. 1; साधु रे पिंगल वानर साधु

.
--2 Enough, away with.
--Comp.
--आचार a. well-conducted, pious,
virtuous.
--ज a. noble, of a noble
family.
--दर्शन a. {1} good-looking.
{2} thoughtful, prudent.
--धी a.
kind, well-disposed. (--f.) a
motherin-law.
--भावः kindness.
--वादः a
cry of ‘well done’, a cry of
approbation; Śi. 18. 55.
--वाहः, --वाहिन्
m. a well-trained horse.
--वृक्षः the
Kadamba tree.
--वृत्त a. {1}
wellconducted, upright, virtuous; प्रयेण
साधुवृत्तानामस्थायिन्यो विपत्तयः

; (where the next sense is also
intended). {2} well-rounded.
--(त्तः)
a virtuous man.
--(त्तं) good
conduct, virtue, piety, righteousness;
so साधुवृत्ति.

साधिष्ठ a.
1 Best, most
excellent, most proper.
--2 Very strong,
hard or firm (superl. of. साधु or वाढ
q. v.).

.
--2 Harder, stronger;
(compar. of साधु or वाढ q. v.).
--3
More handsome.
--4 More proper
or right.

1 A stall, shop.
--2 An
umbrella.
--3 A flock of peacocks.

1 A virtuous or chaste
woman.
--2 A faithful wife.
--3 N.
[]
of a kind of root.
